search_window.basis: Start boundary: completed_at of prior independently read-back-verified Food Line heartbeat. Targeted web searches used a 2-day indexing allowance; only fresh qualifying events newly established since that boundary eligible.

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall only, not authoritative nationwide production collector; four targeted miss classes: sole/last/full-service grocery loss, hazard-canceled emergency food distribution, abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction, official immediate SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption.

Twelve targeted web searches ran without a search-tool error. No independently verified new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption had event/publication timing in the observation window. Search results contained historical incidents and unrelated/routine notices; index recency filters did not ensure result publication within two days.

Excluded Sept. 11/14 Spencer, NY sole grocery fire; Sept. 25 El Paso food-bank storm closure; Oct. 7 Alabama pantry weather cancellation; Oct. 29 Kauaʻi recovery distribution still scheduled for Oct. 30. Excluded 2025 federal-shutdown/SNAP notices, routine food-distribution schedules and holiday promotions.
No approvals, public publications, schedule changes, task disabling, or production workflow mutations.
